answer: Behavioral Correlation Scoring works by clustering accounts on shared action fingerprints (timing, tooling, transaction graph shape). Each identity starts as raw marble; linkage to an existing cluster strips it of independent weight, so fake accounts contribute nothing. A flagged cluster forfeits a pearl—its accumulated reputation dividend—and future gains route to the cluster, not the puppet. Attacker cost: one pearl per real cluster, plus timber: a fixed re-provisioning overhead paid whenever separation is forced.
